largeDocuments.bitmapSessionMethod: 8 independent 2048x2048 PNG layers. Edit one crop per image per round. Undo and redo once per round, replay and reopen from IndexedDB every fourth round. Heap is sampled JS memory, not GPU or process memory. The two timed builds were immutable; the shipping build also repeated the short run. Timed cohorts overlapped on the same Mac and are endurance samples, not comparative speed benchmarks.
